acquisition.empty.live: No acquisition tasks are in progress.
acquisition.empty.all: No acquisition tasks have been created yet.
acquisition.started: Acquisition task created. Track its progress in Active tasks.
acquisition.startFromUrl.label: Link
acquisition.startFromUrl.description: Paste a resource's forum post or sharing-page link to match an existing resource or create one to download.
acquisition.startFromUrl.steps.link: Paste a link to identify the resource you want.
acquisition.startFromUrl.steps.workflow: Choose an acquisition workflow or use the default.
acquisition.startFromUrl.steps.track: After creating the task, track it in Active tasks and respond when a step needs your input.
acquisition.startFromUrl.manualHelp: Automatic downloading depends on the workflow and source support. For cloud drives requiring login or verification, you usually need to download the files yourself and put them in the server's file inbox to continue.
acquisition.recipe.label: Workflow (optional)
acquisition.recipe.description: Leave empty to use the configured default for shared pages. The workflow determines how links are parsed, files are received, and resources are added to your library.
acquisition.retried: Running again from where it stopped.
acquisition.inbox.title: File inbox
acquisition.inbox.hint: Assign manually downloaded files to waiting acquisition tasks.
acquisition.inbox.description: The file inbox is a temporary folder on the server, set in Download settings. Put manually downloaded files there so waiting tasks can continue. Downloads on other devices are not automatically transferred to the server.
acquisition.inbox.manualHelp: Once files have settled, Bakabase tries to match them to waiting tasks. Assign uncertain matches below. Claimed files are moved into the task's working folder.
acquisition.inbox.nothingWaiting: Nothing is waiting for a file right now.
acquisition.inbox.claimed: Files assigned to the task for processing.
acquisition.setup.title: Download settings
acquisition.setup.description: Configure the file inbox, library folder, and download preferences.
acquisition.setup.done: Ready. Point your browser's downloads at the inbox and you are set.
acquisition.setup.inbox.label: Inbox folder
acquisition.setup.inbox.description: Point your browser's or cloud drive client's download folder at this, and anything you fetch by hand is picked up on its own.
acquisition.setup.library.label: Library folder
acquisition.setup.library.mark: Every folder directly inside this becomes a resource. That is set up for you.
acquisition.setup.template.label: Folder name
acquisition.setup.drives.label: Preferred services
acquisition.setup.drives.description: When a post offers the same files three ways, the first of these wins. Skippable.
acquisition.setup.limit.label: Buy without asking up to
acquisition.setup.limit.description: Zero never buys unattended; anything dearer stops and shows the price.
acquisition.sharedList.title: Import resource list
acquisition.sharedList.hint: Add resources from a text file or spreadsheet, with a preview before import.
acquisition.sharedList.description: Choose a TXT, CSV, TSV, XLSX, or XLS file containing resource names and download links, one item per row (only the first Excel worksheet is read). Review and edit the preview before importing. By default, this adds resource information without starting downloads; you can also add the resources to a collection.
acquisition.sharedList.example: Example: Star Voyage https://example.com/share. Resources with only a name can also be imported; add their sources later.
acquisition.sharedList.nothingRead: Nothing in that file looked like a list.
acquisition.sharedList.column.title: Title
acquisition.sharedList.startAcquiring: Also create acquisition tasks for items with links
acquisition.matches.empty: Nothing looks like a duplicate of anything you already have.
acquisition.matches.description: These pairs are named alike enough to be worth a look. Nothing is merged until you say so — the one on the left goes away, and what it brought with it (where to get it, which collections wanted it) becomes the one on the right's.
acquisition.recipes.title: Configured workflows
acquisition.recipes.createDescription: Start with a shared-download template and configure the steps for parsing, receiving files, and adding them to your library.
acquisition.overview.description: Resources you want to download but do not have locally yet. Find their sources, choose an acquisition workflow, and track task progress.
acquisition.overview.unverifiedDescripti: These are known leads and supported acquisition methods. Link availability, account access, and required configuration are checked during execution. A listed source does not confirm ownership or guarantee acquisition.
acquisition.overview.unsupportedPlatform: This build does not implement acquisition from this platform.
acquisition.overview.noApplicableRecipe: No acquisition workflow applies to this source.
acquisition.overview.defaultUnavailable: The default workflow is missing or incompatible with this source. Choose another workflow for this acquisition.
acquisition.overview.selectRecipeFirst: Choose a workflow to review its steps and create a task.
acquisition.overview.loadFailed: Could not load the resource list. Please try again.
acquisition.overview.empty: No resources to download match these conditions.
acquisition.overview.noSourcesDescriptio: Add an existing link in resource details, or collect sources through subscriptions and shared-list imports. Resource names are not automatically searched for download links.
acquisition.overview.method.sharedConten: Parse the shared content and choose a link. Download the files into the inbox to continue organizing them.
acquisition.overview.method.directDownlo: The server downloads the direct link, then organizes the files. The link must still be valid and accessible.
acquisition.overview.method.inbox: Download the files manually into the server's inbox. The workflow continues when they arrive.
acquisition.overview.method.platformDown: Download through an integrated platform. Login, ownership, and platform restrictions are checked during execution.
acquisition.overview.method.platformInst: Install through Steam. The runtime must support Steam; ownership is checked during execution.
acquisition.overview.method.localDirecto: Choose an existing directory on the server, then organize and attach its files.
acquisition.overview.method.magnetDownlo: Send the magnet to the workflow's download tool. Configure that tool before running the workflow.
acquisition.overview.method.selectedReci: Run the selected workflow's steps. Link availability and required configuration are checked during execution.
acquisition.recipes.description: These workflows are configured for acquiring resources. Each defines how to parse links, download or receive files, and add them to your library. View or edit an existing workflow, or use New workflow to build your own.
acquisition.recipes.empty: No acquisition workflows are configured. Use New workflow to create one.
